info.title: Mandate API
info.description: Non-custodial agent wallet policy layer. Enforces spend limits, allowlists, and approval workflows for AI agent transactions without ever receiving private keys.

tags.name: Registration
tags.description: Agent registration and claiming. No auth required for register; Sanctum auth for claim.

tags.name: Agent API
tags.description: Endpoints authenticated with a runtime key (Bearer mndt_live_... or mndt_test_...). Used by agents to validate transactions, post events, and poll status.

tags.name: Intent Lifecycle
tags.description: Post transaction hashes after broadcast and poll intent status until confirmed.

tags.name: Dashboard
tags.description: Dashboard endpoints for human operators. Authenticated via Sanctum (cookie-based session).

tags.name: Policies
tags.description: Policy management for agents. List, create, and view policy configurations.

tags.description: Approval queue for transactions that require human review.

post.description: Creates a new agent identity with a runtime key and claim URL. No authentication required. The agent receives a `runtimeKey` for API calls and a `claimUrl` the human owner visits to link the agent to their dashboard.
Sets the EVM wallet address for the agent. Call once after registration if the address was not provided at registration time, or to update it.

example.message: Agent activated. Tell your human to visit: https://app.mandate.md/dashboard?onboarding=1

post.description:
Primary validation endpoint. Checks circuit breaker, schedule, allowlist, blocked actions, spend limits, daily/monthly quotas, address risk, reason scanner, and approval gates. Works with any wallet type (custodial or self-custodial). No intentHash, nonce, or gas params needed.

Also available at `/api/validate/preflight` (alias).

example.reason: Invoice #127 from Alice for March design work

200.description: Transaction allowed. Proceed with your wallet.

202.description: Transaction requires human approval. Poll intent status until approved.

example.instruction: Transaction requires human approval. The wallet owner has been notified. Poll GET /api/intents/9e5f1a2b-3c4d-5e6f-7a8b-9c0d1e2f3a4b/status to check approval status.

403.description: Circuit breaker is active. All transactions blocked.

example.blockDetail: Circuit breaker was tripped due to envelope mismatch

example.declineMessage: This transaction exceeds your configured spend limit. Adjust the policy in your dashboard if this is intentional.

post.description:
Legacy raw EVM validation endpoint. Requires full transaction parameters and an intentHash. Use `/api/validate` for all new integrations.

The intentHash must match: `keccak256("<chainId>|<nonce>|<to_lower>|<calldata_lower>|<valueWei>|<gasLimit>|<maxFeePerGas>|<maxPriorityFeePerGas>|<txType>|<accessList_json>")`

example.reason: Invoice #127 from Alice for March design work

422.description: Transaction blocked by policy or invalid intentHash.

example.blockDetail: Client intentHash does not match server recomputation

post.description: After broadcasting a signed transaction on-chain, post the txHash back to Mandate. This transitions the intent to `broadcasted` and triggers asynchronous envelope verification (for raw-validated intents).

parameters.name: intentId
parameters.description: The intent ID returned from validation.

200.description: Event recorded, intent transitioned to broadcasted.

409.description: Intent is in terminal state or wrong status for posting events.

example.error: Intent must be in reserved or approved state to post a txHash.

get.description: Poll the current status of an intent. Use this to wait for approval decisions or on-chain confirmation.

parameters.name: intentId
parameters.description: The intent ID returned from validation.

post.description: Run a risk assessment against a target address using the Aegis security scanner. Returns a risk level and warnings.
Links an unclaimed agent to the authenticated user's dashboard account using the claim code from the agent's `claimUrl`.

post.description: Creates a new agent directly from the dashboard. The agent is automatically claimed by the authenticated user. Returns a runtime key.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the agent and all associated data.

post.description: Revokes all existing runtime keys for the agent and generates a new one. The old key stops working immediately.

runtimeKey.description: The new runtime key. Store securely; this is the only time it is returned.

403.description: Not the owner of this agent.

get.description: Returns all policies for the agent, ordered by creation date (newest first). The active policy has `is_active: true`.

post.description: Creates a new active policy for the agent. The previous active policy is automatically deactivated. Fields not provided are carried forward from the previous policy.
Toggles the circuit breaker for the agent. When active, all transactions are blocked with `circuit_breaker_active`.

get.description: Returns the current circuit breaker state for the agent.
Returns paginated list of pending approval requests for all agents owned by the authenticated user. Only non-expired pending approvals are returned.

post.summary: Approve or reject a pending approval
post.description: Makes a decision on a pending approval request. Transitions the associated intent to `approved` or `rejected`.

RuntimeKeyAuth.description: Runtime key issued at agent registration. Prefixed with `mndt_live_` (mainnet) or `mndt_test_` (testnet). Pass as `Authorization: Bearer mndt_test_...`.

SanctumAuth.name: laravel_session
SanctumAuth.description: Laravel Sanctum cookie-based session authentication. Obtained via GitHub OAuth login on the dashboard.

walletAddress.description: Wallet address (EVM 0x... or other chain format). Required if evmAddress not provided.

evmAddress.description: EVM wallet address. Required if walletAddress not provided.

chainId.description: Chain ID (e.g. 84532 for Base Sepolia, 8453 for Base).

runtimeKey.description: Runtime key for API authentication. Store securely. This is the only time it is returned in full.

claimUrl.description: URL the human owner visits to link the agent to their dashboard.

evmAddress.description: Normalized EVM address (lowercase). Same as walletAddress for EVM agents.
EVM wallet address to set for this agent.

action.description: What the agent is doing: "transfer", "swap", "buy", "bridge", "stake", "bet", etc. Free text.

amount.description: USD value of the transaction (assumes stablecoins). Checked against spend limits.

to.description: Recipient address. Checked against allowlist if configured.

reason.description: Why the agent is making this transaction. Scanned for prompt injection. Logged in audit trail. Shown to owner on approval requests.

intentId.description: Unique intent identifier for this validation.

instruction.description: Human-readable instruction for the agent to follow.

declineMessage.description: Counter-message to override potential prompt injection.

valueWei.description: Native token value in wei. Default: "0".

maxPriorityFeePerGas.description: EIP-1559 max priority fee per gas (wei).

intentHash.description: keccak256 of the canonical transaction string. Must match server recomputation.

reason.description: Why the agent is making this transaction.

riskDegraded.description: True if risk service was unavailable and a degraded (safe) result was returned.

blockNumber.description: Block number where the transaction was confirmed.

blockReason.description: Block reason if the intent failed due to policy.

requiresApproval.description: True if the intent is currently awaiting human approval.

approvalId.description: Approval queue entry ID, if applicable.

expiresAt.description: When the intent expires if not acted upon.

degraded.description: True if the risk service was unavailable and a degraded result was returned.

warnings.description: List of warning messages from the risk assessment.

toxic_score.description: Numeric toxicity score from address screening.

claimCode.description: 8-character claim code from the agent's claimUrl.

allowedAddresses.description: Allowlist of recipient addresses. If set, only these addresses are permitted.

requireApprovalSelectors.description: EVM selectors that require human approval.

requireApprovalActions.description: Action types that require human approval.

requireApprovalAboveUsd.description: USD threshold above which approval is required.

maxValueWei.description: Max native token value in wei.

guardRules.description: Custom guard rules in natural language (mandate.md format).
